buttons.label: Meet in castle
buttons.script: const servant=[...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='friendly-servant');servant.entity.setPosition(-7,2.04,-12);const s=[...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='latch-slug');for(const c of objects.getAll('castle'))for(const d of c.destructibleDoors)d.testOpenAmount=1;s.entity.rigidbody.teleport(0,2.04,-5);s.runtime.getHero().entity.rigidbody.teleport(0,2.04,-2.5);s.pack.leader=null;s.resumeBehavior();camera.setViewport({zoom:5,rotation:2,panX:0,panZ:-3.6});map.friendlyView?.off();const view=s.app.on('prerender',()=>{const c=s.runtime.camera;c.component.orthoHeight=1.65;c.entity.setPosition(-.45,3.35,-5.7);c.entity.lookAt(0,2.7,-3.6);s.patPresentation.hud.update();});s.entity.once('destroy',()=>view.off());map.friendlyView=view;

buttons.label: Closed doors
buttons.script: for(const c of objects.getAll('castle')) for(const d of c.destructibleDoors) d.testOpenAmount=0;

buttons.label: Open doors
buttons.script: for(const c of objects.getAll('castle')) for(const d of c.destructibleDoors) d.testOpenAmount=1;

buttons.label: Beside entrance
buttons.script: const slug = [...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id === 'latch-slug'); const door = objects.getAll('castle')[0].entranceDoors[0]; const p = door.entity.getPosition(); slug.entity.rigidbody.teleport(p.x,p.y+0.03,p.z-0.7); slug.testPlayClip('idle_dog'); camera.setViewport({zoom:7,rotation:2,panX:p.x,panZ:p.z-0.7});
